explore.title: Explore the
explore.description: Read Scripture in hundreds of translations with our free, beautifully designed Bible explorer. No account required.
explore.multipleTranslationsDesc: Read in many languages and versions — King James, World English, Berean Standard, American Standard, Reina-Valera, and hundreds more.
explore.cleanReadingDesc: A distraction-free interface built for focused Scripture reading, in light or dark theme.
explore.easyNavigationDesc: Jump to any book or chapter instantly, and keep moving with prev/next that carries you across book boundaries.
explore.seoOptimizedDesc: Every chapter and every Bible character has its own link — send a friend straight to the passage.
explore.clickToPreview: Click any Bible to see the reader preview →

hero.title: Study the Bible,
hero.description: Most Bible apps hand you a verse and move on. The Holy Beacon gives you AI study plans, three ways through every chapter — read it, hear it narrated, or type it — plus profiles of the people behind the text and notes that stay attached to the verse.

studyPlans.title: Learn With
studyPlans.description: The beating heart of The Holy Beacon is its AI study plan generator. Describe what you want to learn and get a structured plan — passage by passage, session by session — with your progress tracked as you go.
studyPlans.customDurationDesc: From quick daily devotionals to in-depth multi-week studies, tailor your plan to fit your schedule.
studyPlans.adjustableDepthDesc: From beginner-friendly introductions to theological deep dives for seasoned scholars.
studyPlans.thematicExplorationDesc: Focus on specific themes like forgiveness, leadership, or end times prophecy.
studyPlans.whatToStudy: What would you like to study?

features.title: Everything
features.description: Not a verse-a-day app. Every chapter comes with the people in it, narrated audio, your own notes, and the study structure to work through it.
features.moreOnRoadmap: See what lands in the next two quarters

scriptureHD.title: Scripture in HD
scriptureHD.description: Character profiles, cited timelines, and the people behind every chapter.
scriptureHD.modalDescription: Know who you are reading about, not just what happened.
scriptureHD.preview1Desc: Browse every person named in Scripture, with their alternate names, dates, and every passage they appear in — free and open to everyone at /bible/people.
scriptureHD.preview2Desc: See a person's arc across Scripture and how they connect to everyone around them. Every claim is cited to a real verse mention — nothing invented.
scriptureHD.preview3Desc: Names light up inside the text as you read. Tap one to open their profile without losing your place in the chapter.
scriptureHD.preview4Desc: We're building smart verse connections and historical and cultural context layers so you can trace a theme across the whole Bible.

multiModal.title: Multi-Modal Bible
multiModal.description: Read it, hear it, or type it — the same chapter, three ways.
multiModal.modalDescription: Engage with God's Word in the way that works best for you.
multiModal.preview1Desc: A calm, typeset reading mode with nothing competing for your attention — just the text, your notes, and the people in the passage.
multiModal.preview2Desc: Listen to any chapter with two voices, adjustable speed, and verse-by-verse highlighting that follows along. Download for offline listening on your commute.
multiModal.preview3Desc: Type Scripture out word by word with live speed and accuracy. Slower than reading, and that is exactly the point.
multiModal.preview4Desc: Compare two translations of the same passage in a single view — in progress for the next release.

studyNotes.title: Study & Notes
studyNotes.description: AI study plans plus notes that stay attached to the verse.
studyNotes.modalDescription: Structure for your study, and a place to keep what you find.
studyNotes.preview1Desc: Describe what you want to learn and set the length and depth. You get a passage-by-passage plan you can work through session by session, and regenerate any time.
studyNotes.preview2Desc: Attach a note to a single verse, a chapter, a whole book, or a translation. Search across all of them and jump straight back to the passage.
studyNotes.preview3Desc: A fresh verse each day and a streak that counts the days you showed up, with an optional daily reminder by email.
studyNotes.preview4Desc: AI summaries and key themes for any chapter, coming to the reading panel next quarter.

roadmap.title: Feature
roadmap.description: Three phases are live today. Here's what lands over the next two quarters.

phases.title: AI-Guided Study Plans
phases.description: Describe what you want to learn and get a structured, passage-by-passage plan built around your schedule and depth.

phases.title: Scripture in HD
phases.description: The people behind the text — profiles, timelines, and relationships, every claim cited to a real verse.
features: Character profiles A–Z with aliases and dates
AI timelines and relationships, fully cited
People linked inline in every chapter

phases.title: Multi-Modal Bible
phases.description: Three ways through the same chapter, so Scripture fits the moment you're in.
features: Type-the-word mode with speed and accuracy
Narrated audio: two voices, speed control, offline download

phases.title: Deeper Reading Panel
phases.description: More context alongside the text you're reading, without ever leaving the chapter.

phases.title: Community & Daily Word
phases.description: Fellowship features and daily Scripture engagement, so believers grow together and stay consistent.
